_meta.purpose: The ONE feature-tag normalization case table. Two implementations exist - build-data.ps1's Convert-FeatureTag (which builds data/mattresses.json) and tools/validation.py's normalize_feature_tag (which decides whether a quiz scoring key is reachable) - and tests/feature_tag_normalization_check.py executes BOTH against this table so they cannot drift.
_meta.defect_this_exists_for: A4.2 shipped a reachability validator that compared RAW CSV spellings to camelCase quiz keys. build-data.ps1 normalizes kebab-case to camelCase, so a source vocabulary the generator accepts (pressure-relief, motion-isolation) was reported unreachable by the validator - a false build failure on supported input.
contract: a tag with no hyphen is preserved VERBATIM (case included) - the CSV is the authority on its own spelling
a hyphenated tag lowercases its FIRST segment, then appends each subsequent NON-EMPTY segment with its first character upper-cased and the remainder untouched
_meta.ascii_only: Tags are ASCII. .NET ToUpper() and Python str.upper() agree there; a non-ASCII tag is out of contract and would need its own ruling.

cases.note: the kebab source the generator supports and the validator used to reject
first segment lowercased, second keeps its own capital
the second repaired key in kebab form
empty middle segment is skipped, not capitalized
empty FIRST segment: the second segment still gets its capital
empty tag normalizes to empty; callers drop it
the REST of a segment is never re-cased - this is deliberate, and it is why a mis-authored tag stays visible instead of being silently coerced
a hyphen-free tag is NOT lowercased; if the catalog authors it this way it stays unreachable and the validator says so

normalization is not validation - an unknown tag normalizes to itself; whether it matters depends on WHICH side it is on (an unknown quiz scoring key is rejected; an extra catalog feature no quiz rule references is allowed and ignored by scoring)

unknown_tag.note: an EXTRA catalog tag no quiz option awards is not an error - the contract runs quiz -> catalog, not catalog -> quiz

unreachable_quiz_key.note: a quiz key with no carrier and no dormancy declaration is a build error

dormant_becoming_reachable.note: a declared-dormant key that the catalog starts carrying must have its declaration removed in the same change
